original_en: Objects
Dagger\rMade with a reinforced\rtitanium steel blade, this\rdagger would be effective\rwhen used hand to hand\ragainst an opponent without\rarmor.
Sword\rWell balanced and highly\rdecorated, this sword can be\rused both in state ceremonies\ras well as in battle. It\rwould be highly lethal when\rused against an enemy without\rarmor.

Pistol\rMade for U.N.F.A. a security\rweapon, the Baretta 2043-UFS\ractually came into field\rservice in 2044 due to\rproblems with its loading\rsystem.  It fires a standard\rnine millimeter ammunition\rand is very effective at\rshort ranges.
Rifle\rA hunter's weapon, this rifle\ris a long range weapon with\rfair accuracy. Although it is\rnot designed for combat\rsituations, it can be very\rdeadly in that capacity.
Assault Rifle\rWithout a doubt an assassin's\rweapon, this rifle fires high\rpower ammunition with laser\rfine accuracy.

Machine Gun\rVery similar in design to\rU.N.F.A.'s hastily created\rG11-S, this machine gun fires\rcaseless rounds that can\rpenetrate most kinds of\rballistic armor. Like most\rmachine guns, it suffers from\ra very limited effective\rrange.

Hand Laser\rThe innovative design of this\rhand laser is both functional\rand practical.  Using a\rcoiled heat damping system,\rthis weapon design allows\rlaser technology to be\reffective in a hand held\rsize.  It depends on\rammunition in the form of a\rpower cell.

Laser Rifle\rMore accurate than its hand\rheld counterpart, the laser\rrifle is designed for\rslightly heavier tasks which\rrequire more power in a\rlonger burst. In most\rgalactic societies, this has\rbecome the standard medium\rrange weapon.

Assault Laser\rCreated to deliver maximum\rdamage without suffering from\rthe dangers of medium ranged\ropposing fire, the Assault\rLaser has the best of both\rworlds and is a military\rissue weapon of choice.  Only\rthe very best of reflective\rarmors are useful against\rthis weapon.

Electron Gun\rThe fourth and least\reffective in a class of\r"sub-atomic" weapons, the\rElectron class gun creates\rinjuries by stripping the\relectrons from contacted\rmolecular structures, thereby\rseverely injuring any\runshielded targets.

Neutron Gun\rThe third in the class of\r"sub-atomic" weapons, the\rNeutron Gun breaks down the\rmolecular integrity of its\rtarget by a barrage of very\rtightly focused neutrons.\rUnshielded targets are often\rseriously injured by these\rweapons.

Sub-Atomic Blaster\rLike the less developed\rmodels, the sub-atomic\rblaster combines the\rstrategies of electron and\rneutron guns and hits a\rtarget with much stronger\reffect.  In addition, the\rdesigners of the sub-atomic\rblaster have also solved the\rproblems of range and\raccuracy, improving on both\rcounts.

Blue Quark Gun\rCode named project Blue\rQuark, this gun was a top\rsecret weapons development in\rSector Alnasl. Created by the\rOminar for a Dhoven\rcontractor, the Blue Quark\rGun is the first class\r"sub-atomic" weapon.  Firing\ran incredibly dense stream of\ranti-gluons into its target,\rthe gun comes close to\rcompletely disassembling\rthose unfortunate enough to\rfeel its effects.

Smart Gun\rA miniaturized artificial\rintelligence computer has\rbeen combined with a low\rgrade missile launcher to\rcreate this strategic weapon.\rMade to demoralize Scroe\rtroops on the battlefield,\rwhen fired the Smart Gun\rautomatically seeks out the\rstrongest enemy target.\rMorale among the enemy\rcollapses quickly in the face\rof this gun.

Grenade Launcher\rSimilar to those of\rtwentieth-century Earth, this\rgrenade launcher fires\rstandard fletchette type\rgrenades which affect a small\rarea of a few feet. Users\rshould be warned that it is\rpossible to be injured by\r'friendly fire' when using\rweapons of this sort.

Plasma Generator\rUsing very special designs,\rthis gun's developers\rsucceeded in creating a\rlocalized fuel-air explosion\rsimilar to those created by\rlarger fuel-air bombs.\rCreating intense heat\reffects, the plasma generator\roperates much like a\rlarge-scale flamethrower.

Seeker\rA counterpart to the Smart\rGun, the seeker gun also uses\rartificial intelligence and\rrocket launching technologies\rfor its affect. Not limited\rby a strict line of sight,\rthe seeker is capable of\rattacking targets around\rcorners and other\robstructions but does have a\rlimited range.
Acid Gun\rFiring small pellets of a\rhighly corrosive nature, the\racid gun is designed to\rdirectly attack the armor of\ran opponent.

Mono-Mol Disk Gun\rA projectile weapon, the\rmono-mol disk gun fires\rmolecule thick discs at a\rhigh rate of speed, allowing\rthem to penetrate most kinds\rof armor and do damage\rdirectly to the wearer. This\rweapon is highly unreliable,\rhowever, and is known to be\rvery vulnerable to\rTechJamming technologies.

Defense Wave\rStrictly intended as a\rdefensive weapon, the defense\rwave propagator creates a\rglobular electrostatic burst\rthat is centered around the\ruser, doing damage to anyone\rand anything that stands in\rfront, behind or next to the\rdefender.  It is advised that\rthis item not be used in a\r'party' situation.

Mass Cannon\rUtilizing mass driver\rtechnologies to deadly\reffect, this shoulder weapon\rfires a thousand gram\rprojectile from a short mass\rchamber at a velocity in\rexcess of nine hundred feet\rper second. Though it isn't\ralways capable of impaling\rall armor, it does\rsignificant damage while\rignoring any armored effects.

Turbo Laser\rTermed by its inventor as a\r+suicide+ weapon, the turbo\rlaser fuses all of its\rcomponent parts as it fires\rits lethal burst. Effective\ronly at very short ranges,\rthese lasers are fatal to\rnearly anything that they\rtouch.

Cygnus Cannon\rAn inscription on the stock\rof the cygnus cannon gives\rall the details of the\rconstruction of this weapon\rof revenge.  Entirely unique\rin the galaxy, unmatched even\rby the technologies of the\rOminar or the Ipremi, the\rCygnus Cannon is capable of\rfiring a stream of stripped\rgravitons, in effect,\rcreating a pseudo-black hole\rin the center of its focal\rrange. When concentrated on\rany opponent, it will kill\rinstantly.

Chain Sword\rAn ingenuity created by the\rsettlers on Rutilicus Colony\rin Sector Kornephoros, the\rchain sword was created so\rthat settlers could have a\rdevice that would allow\rdefense against Cin-Sae Spawn\rwhile also having a device\rwith more practical purposes.

Rocket Launcher\rModified from a basic grenade\rlaunch design, this rocket\rlauncher is a line of sight\rweapon capable of greater\rrange and damage than other\rsimilar weapons. Novices\rshould be warned that the\rweapon is as dangerous to\rfriendly parties as to\rhostile when used improperly.
Death Ray\rA microwave transmitter has\rbeen coupled with a moderate\rpower supply in this simple\rhand held weapon. Aptly\rnamed, this death ray will\rkill most unarmored opponents.

Microtic Injector\rStealing technology developed\rfor the needler guns, the\rMicrotic Injector is a\rhypervelocity injection\rsystem which introduces a\rmicrotic army into the body\rof an opponent. Once\rinside,microts then attack\rwhatever systems they\rencounter until their power\rsupplies fail. Also a good\rdevice for injecting\rStrandware into a host.

Tac Nuke Rifle\rOperating more like a rocket\rlauncher than a rifle, this\rweapon fires a\rmicro-miniature fissionable\rcharge into a specified zone.\rOnce there it detonates with\ra titanic blast. Victims\rsuffer both radiation and\rprojectile damage.

Breach Missile\rUsing highly complex armor\rpiercing techniques, this\rmissile launcher does all of\rits damage against any armor\rit encounters, in most cases\rmaking it possible for a\rsecondary attack to do real\rdamage.
Needler\rThis handgun, designed to\rfool Evian Interceptor Armor,\rfires fletched needles which\rspread into a dense cloud\rshortly before they impact.

Imastyl\rEssentially a handless\rdagger, the Imastyl has a\rnumber of ritualistic\rpurposes to the people of\rHenresia. They Who Converse\rare said to use the Imastyl\rto draw the pictures that\rthey use to communicate with\rone another.

Energy Mace\rTactically a very cruel\rweapon, the energy mace does\rmost of its damage when the\rvictim is struck by its five\rhundred gram head. A second\rfeature, an electric shock of\r8000 volts, is delivered to\rthe victim at the same time\rin order to further disable\rthe enemy.

Thermite Launcher\rTaking advantage of the\rsimilarity of the grenade\rlaunchers made by the traders\rin Sector Algieba, the Ethnys\rcreated the Thermite\rLauncher, a weapon that\rbathes its targets in flame.

Scroe Special\rThe so-called 'scroe-special'\ris in fact a substandard\rpistol that fires caseless\rrounds. Usually only used by\rthe Scroe for purposes of\rinternal security, it\rsometimes is sold on the open\rmarket. This particular model\rappears to be in very poor\rshape.

Battle Laser\rSlighty heavier than an\rAssault Laser, the Battle\rLaser is very long ranged but\rsacrifices a significant\rdegree of its punch to make\rthe range possible. Weapons\rof this sort have reduced the\rnecessity of short range\rbattles that have been\rdictated by shorter ranged\rlaser weapons.

Sossee Dagger\rStrictly a ceremonial weapon,\rthis dagger is greatly\rrevered as a holy symbol.\rUsed in mystery rites for\rages, it now tours\rperiodically as an art\robject. HabStel on Starport\rKochab has reportedly bid\rlarge sums to gain possession\rof the dagger but have so far\rbeen unsucessful.

Laser Sword\rPulsed bursts of laser energy\rare used to create the\r+blade+ of this curious item.\rAlthough it has several\rredeeming features, it\rsuffers from great\rsusceptibility to TechJam and\ris somewhat unwieldy to those\runused to using such an\relaborate weapon.

Plasma Bow\rThis weapon combines the\rgrace of archaic weaponry\rwith the destructive power of\rmodern technology. The plasma\rbow shoots concentrated bolts\rof plasma energy that strike\rand burn their target. A\rgreat deal of damage is done\ragainst foes not wearing\rarmor.
Super Laser\rThe most powerful of the\rlaser weapons, the Super\rLaser operates at the long\rrange of the Battle Laser\rwithout sacrificing\rdestructive capabilities.
Atomizer\rThe atomizer delivers a\rfocused beam of x-ray\rradiation that is able to \rpenetrate most normal types\rof armor. Not very effective\ragainst archaic armor.
Leather Armor\rBeautifully tooled, this\rleather armor should be able\rto turn back the blades of\rdaggers and reduce damage\rfrom conventional swords.

Chain Mail\rThousands of wrought iron\rrings have been linked\rtogether to form this superb\rsuit of low-tech armor.\rCapable of stopping daggers\rand swords, it is still\rvulnerable to penetration by\rarrows and other projectile\rweapons.

Plate Mail\rPolished to a shine, this\rplate mail is astonishingly\rsimilar to the plate mail\rfound on Earth during its\rmedieval period. Although it\rwould be poorly matched\ragainst firearms, it should\rstop any less severe kind of\rprojectile attack.
Flak Jacket\rA fairly heavy form of armor,\rthe flak jacket is designed\rto stop small arms fire at\rshort range. Heavier\rprojectile weapons may still\rpenetrate the skin of this\rarmor.

Kevlar Suit\rNot so heavy as the standard\rflak jacket, the Kevlar Suit\ris far better suited to\ractual combat situations and\rallows greater freedom of\rmovement. Capable of\rwithstanding heavy arms fire\rat moderate ranges, this is\rthe basic armor that most\rlow-tech societies use for\rthe protection of their\rmilitaries.

Composite Armor\rCombining lightweight\rconstruction and high stress\rflexibility, this armor is\rcapable of withstanding small\rand moderate arms fire while\rit is still in good\rcondition. Elite officers are\roften issued this armor.

Reflec Armor\rPitted with thousands of\rsmall parabolic reflectors,\rthis is a high tech armor\rdesigned to shed the\rdevastating effects of small\rlaser fire. Larger scale\rlasers are capable of eating\rquickly through this armor.

Ceramic Armor\rLess vulnerable than reflec\rarmor, ceramic armor can\rwithstand great heat before\rsuccumbing to the effects of\rlaser fire. Wearers should be\radvised, however that a\rprojectile weapon could still\reasily breach such armor.

Evian Armor\rDuring the vicious years of\rthe Attrition Conflict, the\rEvians developed this\rfrightening looking black\rarmor as a defense against\rthe rapid-fire weapons\rwielded by the Scroe trench\rarmies. Utilizing a special\rpair of lasers attached to\rthe shoulders of the armor,\rincoming projectiles are\rautomatically vaporized as\rthey approach until the\rsuit's power supply is\rexhausted.
Personal Shield\rThis force-field based armor\ris capable of shedding both\rlaser and 'sub-atomic' fire,\rbut has a relatively low\rbreach value.

Modu-Armor\rThis is an active armor\rdesigned to stop 'sub-\ratomic' damage to the wearer.\rBy creating a modulating\rvirtual wall of neutrons\raround the wearer, it endows\rthe ability to see a target\rwhile still providing a solid\rshield around them. If it\rreceives more damage than it\rcan vent, the field will then\rfall apart.

May Field\rDeveloped by Ageus May, this\renergy field has proven to be\rthe most effective armor\ragainst 'sub-atomic' attack.\rBy generating a field of\rgluons around the wearer,\rthis field effectively sheds\rneutron and electron class\rguns. As with the other types\rof 'sub-atomic' armors, it\rstands a chance of\roverloading and imploding on\rits wearer.

Admantine Chain\rThis chain mail is the very\rfinest armor that is possible\rwithin a low-tech society.\rCapable of stopping even\rarrows and small arms fire,\rthis chain is the finest in\rany class of armor.
Teflar Suit\rHighly heat resistant and\rflexible, laser and\rprojectile weaponry are\rchallenged to breach the skin\rof this suit. It is still\rmoderately vulnerable to\r'sub-atomic' attack.

Assault Suit\rHighly expensive and greatly\rvalued, this armor was\rcreated by the Ominar for\rtheir defense troops on the\rborders of their territories.\rResistant to all types of\rattack, this suit has a high\rbreach value and can\rwithstand most heavy weapons\rfire.

Recon Armor\rMade with the same defenses\ras the Assault Suit, Recon\rArmor was scaled down to\rallow more suits to be made\rwhile cutting costs.\rAlthough its breach value was\rsacrificed, it gained special\rmechanised features which\rallows the wearer to smash\rthrough thin walls. Despite\rits bulky mass, it is still\rquite adequate in battle\rsituations.

Shielded Reflec\rThis special class of reflec\rarmor is designed for\rreconnaissance purposes so\rthat scouting parties stand a\rmoderate chance of survival\rwhen they are unsure of an\renemy's armament. Although\rit is not recommended for\rsustained battles, it is a\rvery good armor for hit and\rrun missions.
Dreadnaught Suit\rThe Dreadnaught Suit is the\rtoughest armor available in\rthe known galaxy. It offers\rthe greatest protection \ragainst most weapons.
Escape Code\rA thin plastic card with the\rwords 'Escape Code' written\rin the language of the\rOminar. Tiny bumps on the\rsurface of the card form an \rintricate pattern.

K-Beam\rOne of the eight pieces of\rthe Centauri Device.  The\rK-Beam generator creates a\rselectively permeable wall of\rpositrons designed to prevent\runwanted matter from coming\rthrough the wormhole.
Harmonic Resonator\rOne of the eight pieces of\rthe Centauri Device.  The\rHarmonic Resonator generates\rgravity waves in the patterns\rneccessary to open the\rwormhole.
Omega Card\rA thin plastic card with a \rrepresentation of the Alkaid\rsystem engraved on it.
Silver Locket\rA filigreed silver locket in\rthe shape of a royal seal.
Key Card\rDesigned to be used with\rmagnetic door locks, this key\rcard is backed with a thin\rferrous- sensitive tape.

Algiebian Crystal\rThese crystals have\rtremendous value as power\rsources.  When excited in a\rwarp field, the Algiebian\rCrystals emit a singularly\rcomplex wave which can be\ramplified by a Mass\rConverter. This is one of the\reight pieces of the Centauri\rDevice.

Algiebian Quarter\rThe face of this Algiebian\rcoin is stamped with the\rimage of Ishtao, president of\rthe Algiebian Empire.\rAlthough coinage has largely\rgone out of use within their\rsystems, they still use coins\rfor vending purposes.
Kochab-Cola\rBitter tasting and dark, it\rseems remarkable that this\rsoft drink would be popular\rin any sector of the galaxy.\rIt is particularly favored by\rthe Algiebians.

Newspaper\rThe newspaper is filled with\rthe usual tabloid fare.\rLIZARDESS WOMAN GIVES LIVE\rBIRTH! graces its cover, but\runder it is a story about the\rGeal A'nai. The cult has\rreportedly been hijacking\rships in the system.
Vegan Wine\rPressed by the Ominar, Vegan\rwine has a number of unusual\rproperties. Known to be very\rintoxicating, it is largely\rprohibited in many societies.
Press Pass\rThe press pass bears the\rmasthead logo of the "Nightly\rStalker", the only state\rfunded newspaper on Algieba.
Geal A'nai Amulet\rA deeply religious people,\rmany of the Algiebians belong\rto a monastic order known as\rthe Geal A'nai. This amulet\ris often recognized as being\rthe sign of their faith.

Sixth Seal\rSuspended on a chain, the\rSixth Seal is one of five\rsuch amulets that is said to\rhave mystical powers.  The\rSixth is markedly different\rin that it has a key-like\rextrusion at its top which\rallows it to open locks that\rhave been made by the Geal\rA'nai.

President's Amulet\rTraditionally passed from one\rTorm to the next, the amulet\ris now a symbol of the\rrightful leader of the\rAlgiebian people. Many\rreligious leaders say that\rthe amulet grants its bearer\rgreat luck.
Security Card\rStriped with a bar code on\rthe back, this card allows a\rbearer to enter any door on\rthe Presidential Station in\rorbit of Algieba IV.

Algiebian Tal\rThe primary unit of monetary\rexchange within the confines\rof the Algiebian Empire, the\rTal is made of solid gold.\rDespite the inflation that\rruns rampant in the sector,\rthe Tal may still be used for\rthe purchase of wines and\rother necessities.
Visitor Badge\rGrants to the bearer\rvisitation rights to the\rSabik Mining Colony in Sector\rKornephoros.
Industrial Badge\rThis card identifies the\rholder as a trading agent for\rthe Sabik Mining Colony.\rAllows greater visitation\rrights than those granted by\rthe Visitor's Badge.

Sector Clearance Card\rThe Sector Clearance Card is\rmade of a crystaline material\rpermeated with gossamer veins\rof green conduit.  It contains\rall the information necessary\rto fool the communication\rcomputers on Eltanin VII thus\rallowing you authorized access\rfor terminal use.
Skocha Roots\rAn odd clump of vegetable\rmatter, these roots have a\rmild juice in them that is\rusually consumed by Danteans\rto shield them from the\reffects of severe radiation.
Pikor\rA mining implement, the Pikor\ris used on several colonies\rin the local group.  A good\rtool for removing boulders\rthat block your path.
Bag Of Diamonds\rA common form of galactic\rexchange, there appear to be\rseveral diamonds of value in\rthis bag.  They are\respecially favored by the\rEthnys and Utreceian races.
Blast Wear\rMade to protect the wearer\rfrom intense heat and\renvironmental conditions,\rblast wear is a necessary\ritem for people to wear on\rthe surface of Sabik.
Infra Specs\rDesigned to make infra\rencoded messages visible,\rthese goggles are commonly\rused in the Kornephoros\rsector.
Prong\rThis peculiar object appears\rto have been broken off of\rsome larger object.  Whatever\rfunction it once served, it\rwould seem to be useless now.
Doorspiker\rThis triple pronged key was\rspecially made to fit the\rhands of the Dantean race. An\rinscription code on the\rhandle of the key suggests\rthat it unlocks a door on\rSabik Mining Colony.

ComNav Sq 2345-8.\rThe design of this electronic\rpart would seem to suggest\rthat it is used as a warp\rfield stabilizer for cargo\rclass ships. Although it is\runsuitable for Earth designs,\rit might have value to\rtraders in Sector Caroli.

Gold Wire\rFused at the ends, this\rbroken piece of wire may have\rmelted loose from a larger\rsection of cable. If it is\rused to reconnect the circuit\rit once serviced, it might\rdistract any Microtic\ractivity nearby.

Logic Circuit Alpha\rThis circuit is the main\rcontrol gate for the\roperation of a Gravitic\rCompressor. If a Beta class\rcircuit is swapped for it, it\rmay cause a reversal of the\rcompression field.
Logic Circuit Beta\rThis circuit, when used as a\rsecondary circuit, controls\rminor logic functions. When\rplaced in an Alpha Logic\rtower, it will reverse a\rminiaturization field.
Strand Viewer\rIf used on Ominar strandware,\rthis device can allow close\rscrutiny of the condition of\rthe material.  It is commonly\rused to sort good strandware\rfrom bad.

Gravitic Compressor\rOne of the eight vital parts\rto the Centauri Device, the\rGravitic Compressor is used\ras the focusing device for\rthe titanic forces that are\rgenerated when the K-Beam is\ractivated.

Requisition Form\rSigned by the chief\rcontroller of the Harvest\rtraffic controller team, this\rrequisition form is filled\rout to the chief engineer of\rOortizam Labs. It still\rappears to need a proper\rcounter signature from the\rOminarian director of the\rOortizam Lab.
Authorized Form\rThe form appears to be\rproperly signed and noted. It\rcan be exchanged at the\rEngineering lab on Ooritzam\rfor a ComNav Sq 2345-8.
Mini-Lab Pass\rThis card will allow the\rbearer access to the\rminiaturization lab on\rOoritzam.
Generator\rGasoline fueled, this\rgenerator appears to be very,\rvery old. With some\rmaintenance it might be\rcapable of sustaining a small\rstation's power needs.
Sonic Pincers.\rAn alien analogue to pliers,\rthese sonic pincers appear to\rhave had some rugged use.

Blo\rMade of a dark, reedlike\rmaterial, the Blo is a\rmusical instrument\rmanufactured by the Nuskuan\rrace as a morbid amusement.\rAlthough many modern blos are\rmade from plastic,\rtraditional craftsmen still\rmake them from the appendages\rthat the pre-mature Nuskuans\rshed before becoming adults.
Captain's NoteBook\rA notebook that is used for\rtaking notes.

Thermaul\rA special form of shovel, the\rthermaul is made for digging\rthrough hard packed layers of\rice and snow.  Enhanced with\ra heated, vibrating tip, it\ris the single most important\rtool for those living on icy\rworlds.
Algiebian Invite\rThis invitation will admit a\rparty of visitors to the\rinaugural festivities that\rare underway at Algieba IV.

Talking Stick\rHollowed from a very large\rlog, the talking stick is a\rceremonial symbol of the\runity of the Henresian\rpeople.  It may be worth a\rreward if it is returned to\rthe Magin on Subra II.
Alien Meat\rThe pelt of the That Which\rStalks Blood is very rank,\rits fur steeped in a strong\rmusky odor. They Who Converse\rmight take it in exchange for\ra favor.
Trinket\rThis is the alien equivalent\rof cheap, plastic, jewelry.
Levitator\rA gravitational defeat\rdevice, this levitator can be\rused to move relatively small\robjects.
Matches\rMuch like the matches found\ron Earth, these matches could\rbe used to start a relatively\rsmall fire if set to a\rflammable material.
Queen's Standard\rAlthough not used as a\rmilitary banner any longer,\rthe queen's standard was once\rthe battle flag of the Avian\rpeople. It is now the sole\rsymbol of the Queen of the\rAvians.
Assassins ID\rThe identification code on\rthe card indicates that the\rbearer was from Algieba. It\rseems to implicate that\rIshtao ordered the\rassassination of princess\rJhenna.
Attagi Com-Code\rThe initialization code for\rthe flight controls of the\rstar cruiser Attagi.
Eye Glasses\rMade of light wire and finely\rground glass, the eyeglasses\rdon't appear to have been\rmanufactured for a human\rwearer.
Choasqa Card 1\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
Choasqa Card 2\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
Choasqa Card 3\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
Choasqa Card 4\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
Choasqa Card 5\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
Gravity Bar\rFor reasons unknowable to\rhumans, algiebans consider\rthis device to be worth\rrisking their wealth over.\rThe only known use of a \rgravity bar is Teletrans\rwave modulation.
Technician's ID\rAn I.D. badge that signifies\ryou as an able bodied\rtechnician.
Transformer\rA simple piece of electrical\requipment.
Spare Parts\rMost of the parts in this box\rare fairly low-tech items.\rSpare parts trade is very\rgood in Sector Kornephoros.

Uni-Lock\rA hand held device, the\runi-lock uses a secured\rfrequency to open infrared\rcontrolled locks. Disused in\rmost sections of the galaxy,\rmany traders in Kornephoros\rsector are still forced to\rwork with this outmoded form\rof security.
Deed #38466\rSecured by HabStel's legal\ragents, this planetary deed\rtransfers ownership of a\rplanet in Sector Alhena to\rthe bearer.
Mass Converter\rUsed for the conversion of\rmass to energy, this device\roperates like a large scale\rtele-trans. It is one of the\reight parts required to\rreconstruct the Centauri\rDevice.
Cyber Credit\rBacked by the Cyber bank on\rShadowside, this credit card\rhas a very low circulation,\rcarried usually by members of\rthe trading underworld.  It\ris commonly used by arms\rmerchants.

Perfume\rAlthough its scent is very\runpleasant to humans, this\rperfume is very popular with\rmany alien races. Rather than\rusing antiperspirant methods,\rmany aliens simply apply this\rmixture of crushed grubs to\rthemselves.
10 Credit Card\rThis credit card is only\raccepted on Starport Kochab.\rIt is worth ten credits.
Lozam Loaf\rGolden and full, the lozam\rloaf is made from a grain\rvery similar to wheat. A\rdesigner food, this strain\rhas great promise to end\rcases of famine in this arm\rof the galaxy.
Shroud Admission\rAdmits the bearer and a small\rparty to see the fabled\rShroud of Kriq on display at\rStarport Kochab.
Music Box\rRemarkably like the music\rboxes on Earth, this\rcuriosity looks as if it may\rhave been damaged.
Particle Pak\rThis relatively small item is\ractually the ammunition\rsupply for weapons using sub-\ratomic technologies.

Neutrino Cache\rHeavier than the particle\rpak, the neutrino cache\rcontains neutrinos within a\rvery special field. When used\rwith sub-atomic weapons it\rprovides a hefty ammunition\ras the neutrinos are released\rfrom the field.
Power Cell\rOne of two types of\rammunition available for\rlaser weapons, a power cell\ris the standard energy supply\rfor general issue energy\rweaponry.
Energy Bank\rDesigned specifically for\rassault weapons, this energy\rbank will power heavy energy\rbursts.

Ammo Clip\rNine millimeter shells are\rthe standard load for this\rtype of clip, made\rspecifically to feed the\rBeretta 2043-UFS pistol. A\rsmall adjustment slide on the\rback allows for it to use\rother sizes as need arises.
Heavy Magazine\rDesigned to hold explosive\rtipped loads, the heavy\rmagazine can be used with a\rvariety of different\rprojectile based weapons.
First Aid Pak\rMade to deal with minor\rwounds only, the first aid\rpak is an invaluable aid to\ranyone venturing in dangerous\rterritories.

Trauma Kit\rEquipped with basic first aid\raccessories, this kit is also\renhanced with a small\rcellular regeneration kit.\rAlthough it rapidly depletes\rits energy supply, this item\rcan bring an injured person\rback to complete health if\rthe victim still has minimal\rlife signs.

Shroud of Kriq\rSeized by a cult of religious\rzealots during the great\runrest that was typical of\rthe first years of Sector\rKornephoros, the Shroud of\rKriq is actually a very\rsophisticated piece of\rmedical equipment.  Knitted\rinto this fine net of\rmaterial is a high-tech\rcellular regenerator coupled\rwith an intense biofield\rgenerator. When used, it can\rbring the dead back to life,\rbut its charges are\rstartlingly limited.
Ulfas Cloth\rVery highly valued, this\rcloth is very highly prized,\respecially by traders dealing\rin colonial supplies.
Video Reader\rA small hand held device, it\ris used to scan video\rrecorded documents.  This\rparticular model seems to be\rdefective.
Sonrai Sticks\rNo one is quite certain what\rare done with these strange\rsticks, but the Chytti will\roften pay great sums for\rtheir purchase.
Gallery Admission\rThis ticket will allow a\rparty of visitors to enter\rthe Life Gallery Zoo in\rSector Caroli.

Slieth Egg\rAn endangered species, the\rSlieth are now under the\rEndangered Species Act of\r2031. The largest collection\rof Slieth and Slieth eggs\routside of their native\renvironment is in the Life\rGallery in Sector Caroli.

Caged Nochh\rNoted for their savage\rnature, Nochh are becoming\rincreasingly rare in natural\renvironments. This caged\rcreature would probably have\rthe best chance of survival\rif left in the care of the\rLife Gallery in Sector\rCaroli.
Eldarin Book\rA book of alien origin.
Chytti Book\rA book of alien origin.

Decorative Orb\rOn Denebola IV, a number of\rthese orbs were ordered for\rthe decoration of the\rexterior courtyard of their\rsacred temple. Although most\rhad no function other than to\rlook attractive, some were\rplaced on pedestals in order\rto open secret doors.

Tractor Part\rThis grease covered\rcontraption is actually a\rvery important part in the\roperation of hydrogen\rperoxide engines. It is\rtypically found in tractors\rand harvesters like those\rfound on Alula IV.
Eldarin Pot\rPainted with bright reds and\ryellows, this pot appears to\rbe painted with the\rtraditional logos of the\rancient Eldarin.
Ordinary Key\rRusty and brown, this\rextraordinarily large key\rlooks like it was made to fit\ran old style lock.

*Technical Plans*\rBlueprints, documentations\rand mathematical formulae are\rscrawled on every page on\rthese technical plans. If\rreturned to Moonbase, they\rmay have valuable technical\rinformation that will allow\rthem to upgrade your ship\rconstruction and weaponry.
Fire Extinguisher\rThis device can be used to\rsnuff out flames that can\rblock or injure contact team\rmembers.

Delta Driver\rOne of a set of three highly\rspecialized tools, the Delta\rDriver is a military device\rused in the deactivation of a\rDhoven Proximity Bomb.  When\rused in combination with its\rtwo companion tools it is\rvery safe to use.
Mirror Shard\rMade from a section of plate\rglass and backed with silver,\rthis shard looks like it has\rbeen broken off a larger\rvanity mirror.

Flight Recorder\rTaking the familiar form of\ralien black box technology,\rthis flight recorder will\rhave the travel record of the\rCebis Alban recorded in its\rtape loops. Generally\rstarpilots are the only ones\rcapable of interpreting the\rinformation on them.

Alien Medipak\rDue to the nature of the\rmaterials included in this\rmedical pack, it would be\rhighly inadvisable to\radminister these materials on\ra human being.  The markings\ron the package denote it as\rbeing intended for Cebesians.
Mini Aid Paks\rAlthough most of the medical\rsupplies in this pack are\rincompatible with human\rbiology, some of them should\rwork if correctly applied.
Alien Doll\rThis object is an alien\rplaything, designed in all\rprobability for a young\rCebesian.

Leader's Stone\rThe dark blue stone inset in\rthis piece of jewelry is the\rtraditional symbol of the\rleader of the Cebesians.\rAlthough it has little\rmonetary value, those who\rwear it are treated with\rutmost respect by other\rraces.

Android Tool\rIf used on a damaged android,\rthis remote control can dump\rthe android's last thoughts\rin audio form. This tool is\rvery useful when information\ris needed from heavily\rdamaged androids.
Harvest Key\rThis pass key will unlock the\rdoor to the Control Deck on\rAlula IV.
Sack Of Lozam\rHeavier than it looks, this\rsack of lozam is streaked\rwith brownish slicks of\rlubricant created by leaky\rmechgrippers.
Stone\rA fairly common kind of\rstone, this rock is for the\rmost part featureless.
Ysaf Note\rScrawled hastily in the hand\rof the chief controller on\rAlula IV,this note is\rintended for the Eldarin\rleader, Ysaf, on Denebola IV.
Dhoven Deed\rThis deed has been heavily\rencrypted by a Dhoven legate\rbut does not bear the proper\rfinal seal of approval by the\rSecretary of Sector Affairs.
Numismat Deed\rThis deed, heavily encrypted\rby a Dhoven legate, appears\rto be in order. It bears a\rmark that urges immediate\rdelivery to the Dhoven\rStation at Hyades.

Krupp Shields\rMade of a superdense\rmaterial, the Krupp Shields\rwill prevent radiation leaks\rthat are common with large\rscale engines. It will be\rneeded at Moonbase for the\rreconstruction of the\rCentauri Device.
Planet Deed\rThe deed, though properly\rprocessed, is utterly\rworthless.  It is a deed for\ra dead and mineral poor\rplanet in Sector Alhena.

Fixit Kit\rA Packet of tech tools\rdesigned to repair armor that\rhas been damaged in the\rcourse of duty. The\rcomplexity of the tools would\rsuggest that a character with\ra higher Item Repair ability\rwill get better results from\rthe kit.
Cyber Boots\rA combination of gravitic and\rrobotic technology, the cyber\rboots permit their wearer to\rjump twice as far as before.
Rubber Stamp\rFound in beaurocracies all\racross the universe, the\rrubber stamp is the friend of\rpaper-pushers everywhere.\rThis particular stamp bears\rthe seal of the Numistat of\rAlhena sector.

Alien Regen\rReminiscent of the chemicals\rfound in some zombie movies,\rthis stange spray-on mist\rwill literaly bring the dead\rback to life.  Unfortunately,\rit only makes dead humans\rtwitch a little.  Remember\rthat most aliens don't like\rgetting killed, and may still\rbe a little upset when you\rwake them from the dead.
Ship Plans\rA technical readout of\rsystems designed for a space\rship.

Last Stanza\rThe phrases written on the\rscrap of paper appear to be\rpart of a poem:  Replace my\rname And Secundus fear The\rrevenge of Conciere!  So now\rI claim Defender Last And\rSecundus learn to fear!
Used Eyeballs\rThese cybernetic eyeballs\rrequire cybernetic sockets\rto function properly.
Jar of Uru\rA clear jar filled with a\rsemi-solid jell not\raltogether unlike jam. The \rlid of the jar bears the mark\rof the Ethnys Queen.
Sphere of Themi\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
Golden Trident\rA golden trident with a\rwooden shaft. The artifact\rappears to be ceremonial.\rAnalysis of the metal reveals\rit to be from the Ankaq\rsector.
Coral Instrument\rA delicately crafted musical \rinstrument, made of coral.\rThe design is completely\ralien.
Grav Buoy\rA black, rectangular box full\rof wires with a focusing\rmechanism on one end. The\rmetal of the box is unique to\rthe Zaurak sector.
Wet Suit\rA diving suit with self\rcontained breathing device.\rMuch like an advanced version\rof standard S.C.U.B.A. gear.
Fake Sphere\rA pearl-like sphere. Scans\rdetermine the material of the\rsphere to be an artificial\rrepresentation of another \rsubstance found in the Ankaq \rsystem.
Anti-Mat Grenade\rA powerful grenade.
Mind Net Key\rA thin plastic card with a\rholograph of the word\r'MindNet' on its face.
Control Spike\rA long, thin silver spike\rwith a diamond tip. The tip\ris cut in an intricate shape\rthat suggests its use may be\ras a key.
Control Crystals\rTranslucent crystals grown in\rstrange formations.\rSpectrograph shows the\rcrystals to contain trace \relements found on Alnasl 1.
P.C. Strandware\rA vial of genetic material\rsuspended in fluid. The vial\ris labeled 'Proconsul.'
Regular Strandware\rA vial of genetic material\rsuspended in fluid. The vial\ris labeled 'Standard Ominar.'
Gold Sphere\rA golden globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
Platinum Sphere\rA platinum globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
Bronze Sphere\rA bronze globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
Invisible Idiot\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Invisible Idiot written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
Marathon Victory\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Marathon Victory\rwritten in the language of\rthe Utrece.
Blind Faith\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Blind Faith written in\rthe language of the Utrece.
Virtual Reality\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Virtual Reality written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
Cold Reason\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Cold Reason written in\rthe language of the Utrece.
Sphere of Rhys\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
Sphere of Awa\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
Silver Sphere\rA silver globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
Utrecian Key\rA key.
Mintap\rA small box with three wires \rdangling from one end. The \rconnecters on the ends of the\rwires would suggest this to\rbe some kind of cybernetic\rdata module.
Commnet\rA container with twenty\rreceptacles, or jacks, on\ropposite sides. The device\rappears to be a \rcommunications networking \rstation.
Tschi Tai Pin\rAn identification badge.
Sphere of Harmon\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
Datatape\rA cartridge somewhat like a \rcassette, with magnetic tape\rwound around a graphite core.
Death Threat\rA formal letter addressed to\rMovrin Sepo from Wiretap.
Hataphas Gem\rA gem that looks rather like\ran eyeball. Analysis of the\rmaterial of the gem suggests\rit may originate from Izar 2\rin the Izar sector.
N.I.C.T.U.\rA mechanical device that\rlooks exactly like one of the\rpieces found on the plans for\rthe Centauri device.
Weird Science\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Weird Science written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
Star Stone\rA leather pouch containing\r107 sparkling stones. The\rmaterial of the stones is\rknown to be unique to the\rIzar system.
Jammer\rA small, electro-mechanical\rdevice with a small antenna\rprotruding from one end and a\rred dial in the middle of a\rpalm grip.
Letters\rStationary with writing that\rappears to be in some sort of\rcode.
Official Papers\rIdentification papers.
Algo Cam\rA mechanical device that\rlooks exactly like one of the\rpieces found on the plans for\rthe Centauri device.
ISC Pin\rAn identification badge.
Funny Hat\rA workers cap with a brim\rthat goes all the way around\rit.
Maint Card\rA thin plastic card with\rholographic code printed on\rthe surface.
Nav Beacon\rA small cylindrical shaped\rdevice with flashing lights\ron its ends.
ID Case\rA wooden box with a bottle of\rreddish liquid. Scans\rindicate the liquid to be a\rdistillate of fruits\rindigenous to Vindemiatrix in\rthe Izar sector.
Cevitic Balancer\rA clear plastic globe with\rsmaller globes floating\rinside. Appears to be part of\ra transport beam device.
Optical Key\rA thin plastic card with a \rholographic code printed on\rthe surface. The holographic\ris of Eth/Muni symbols.
